text:
maya: Kicking off canary for model v3.1-quant on the text-generation route. Planning A/B 1% traffic vs baseline for ~6h. Need concrete rollback gates and who owns what.

sam: I can own infra + autoscaling hooks. Proposal: start 1% for 3h, if no alerts -> 5% for another 3h, then 10%. Auto-fallback triggers for latency/error budget.

jordan: What exactly is the quant config? Need to know so evals match serving. Also flag long-context prompts for specific checks.

maya: It's q4_0 with KV cache ON. We saw small quality deltas locally but lower token cost. Main risk: subtle regression on long-form coherence.

luis: I ran the nightly eval suite on a 2k prompt set. Short summary (A/B 1% v3.1q vs baseline):
```
A/B summary (v3.1q vs baseline):
- Rouge-L micro: baseline 42.1 -> v3.1q 41.4  (-0.7 -> -1.7% relative)
- BLEU: baseline 18.0 -> v3.1q 18.2 (+1.1%)
- Hallucination probe (50 prompts): baseline 6% -> v3.1q 8% (+2 pp)
- p50 latency: 85ms -> 105ms (+24%)
- p95 latency: 210ms -> 260ms (+24%)
- Token cost per request: -12% (good)
```
luis: The rouge dip is small but the hallucination probe increase is concerning for long-form. We should gate on hallucination and rouge both.

anya: Product constraints: avoid regression that users notice. Suggested gate list:
- Automated eval score drop >1.5% (rouge/quality) => rollback.
- Hallucination rate increase >1.5 percentage points => rollback.
- Business metric proxy (anchor CTR or rating) decreasing for 4h straight during canary => rollback.

sam: Infra gate proposal:
- p95 latency increase >20% relative => immediate fallback to baseline.
- Error rate (5xx/timeout) >0.5% absolute => immediate fallback.
- Memory OOM or GPU throttling events => immediate fallback.

maya: Add a stability gate for correctness: If automated eval regression exceeds threshold AND hallucination rises, then immediate rollback. If only cost improves with tiny quality dip (<0.5%) we can let it proceed with manual review.

jordan: I'll add an extra eval slice for long-form coherence and persona maintenance. Will push to the dashboard.

ci-bot: Canary job results uploaded: https://ci.internal.re/redwood/canaries/1763501234
ci-bot: Job snippet:
```
canary_step: eval-suite
status: passed_with_warnings
warnings: ["hallucination_probe: 8% (threshold 6%)", "rouge_drop: -0.7 pts"]
```

maya: OK. Action items: I will open PR to update rollout policy with these gates (name: canary-fallback-v3). Sam will wire autoscale + immediate rollback hooks. Jordan & Luis add long-form evals and hallucination probes to the dashboard. Anya will define the business metric proxy and set alert thresholds.

luis: I'll also add a counterfactual test (few-shot prompts) to catch rare hallucinations.

sam: I'll set the auto-rollbacks as enforced policies in the routing layer (no manual override without incident lead approval).

deploy-bot: Canary promoted to 5% after 3h; no infra alerts.

maya: Thanks all. We'll watch the dashboard for the next 6h and reconvene if any gate trips. :eyes:
